task_rice_land_preparation_desc: Plough the field 2-3 times and level it properly.
task_rice_basal_fertilizer_desc: Apply NPK mixture and organic manure as basal dose before transplanting.
task_rice_transplanting_desc: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at proper spacing.
task_rice_first_weeding_desc: Perform hand weeding to control initial weed growth.
task_rice_first_top_dressing_desc: Apply first split dose of Nitrogen (Urea).
task_rice_pest_scouting_desc: Scout for pests like Stem Borer and Leaf Folder.
task_rice_second_top_dressing_desc: Apply second split dose of Nitrogen and Potash.
task_rice_harvesting_desc: Harvest when 80% of the grains are golden yellow.
task_coconut_basin_opening_weeding_desc: Open circular basins around the palm and remove weeds before monsoon.
task_coconut_pre_monsoon_fertilization_d: Apply 1/3 dose of NPK fertilizers along with organic manure.
task_coconut_pest_control_rhinoceros_bee: Place pheromone traps to manage Rhinoceros Beetle.
task_coconut_post_monsoon_fertilization_: Apply remaining 2/3 dose of NPK fertilizers.
task_coconut_irrigation_starts_desc: Start irrigation from December to May if no rain.
task_coconut_harvesting_cycle_desc: Harvesting is typically done every 45-60 days year-round.
task_rubber_fertilizer_application_desc: Apply NPK mixture in May-June after first rains.
task_rubber_disease_management_leaf_fall: Prophylactic spraying for Abnormal Leaf Fall disease during monsoon.
task_rubber_tapping_season_begins_desc: Tapping usually resumes after heavy monsoon season in September.
task_rubber_rain_guarding_desc: Fix rain guards (plastic shields) before monsoon to continue tapping.
task_black_pepper_planting_cuttings_desc: Plant rooted cuttings at the base of support trees.
task_black_pepper_mulching_desc: Apply a thick layer of green leaves as mulch to conserve moisture.
task_black_pepper_first_fertilization_de: Apply first dose of NPK and organic manure in August-September.
task_black_pepper_training_vines_desc: Tie the growing vines to the support tree.
task_black_pepper_disease_watch_quick_wi: Inspect for Quick Wilt disease symptoms, apply preventive drenching.
task_black_pepper_harvesting_desc: Harvest spikes when one or two berries turn yellow-orange.
task_banana_planting_suckers_desc: Plant healthy suckers in well-prepared pits.
task_banana_first_fertilizer_dose_desc: Apply first dose of NPK mixture.
task_banana_de_suckering_desc: Remove unwanted suckers growing from the base.
task_banana_second_fertilizer_dose_desc: Apply second dose of NPK and Potash.
task_banana_propping_desc: Support the plant with bamboo poles as the bunch gets heavy.
task_banana_harvesting_desc: Harvest the bunch when fruits are plump and have turned light green.
task_ginger_planting_rhizomes_desc: Plant seed rhizomes on raised beds.
task_ginger_mulching_desc: Apply first layer of green leaf mulch immediately after planting.
task_ginger_first_fertilization_desc: Apply first split dose of NPK.
task_ginger_second_mulching_weeding_desc: Perform weeding and apply second layer of mulch.
task_ginger_harvesting_desc: Harvest when leaves turn yellow and start to dry.
task_turmeric_planting_rhizomes_desc: Plant mother or finger rhizomes on raised beds.
task_turmeric_mulching_desc: Apply a thick layer of mulch after planting.
task_turmeric_earthing_up_desc: Mound soil around the base of the plants.
task_turmeric_harvesting_desc: Harvest when lower leaves turn yellow.
task_tapioca_planting_cuttings_desc: Plant stem cuttings in mounds or ridges.
task_tapioca_gap_filling_desc: Replant in spots where cuttings failed to sprout.
task_tapioca_first_fertilization_weeding: Apply NPK fertilizer, weed, and perform first earthing up.
task_tapioca_second_fertilization_desc: Apply second dose of fertilizers and final earthing up.
task_tapioca_harvesting_desc: Harvest by uprooting the plants when tubers are mature.
task_cardamom_planting_suckers_desc: Plant suckers in prepared pits in June-July.
task_cardamom_weeding_mulching_desc: Perform regular weeding and mulching around the plant base.
task_cardamom_fertilizer_application_des: Apply first dose of organic and chemical fertilizers in September.
task_cardamom_trashing_desc: Remove old and drying leaves of the plant (trashing).
task_cardamom_harvesting_desc: Harvesting starts from the 3rd year onwards, typically from Oct-Feb.
task_bitter_gourd_trellis_pandal_setup_d: Set up a trellis or pandal for the vines to climb.
task_bitter_gourd_first_fertilization_de: Apply first dose of fertilizer after weeding.
task_bitter_gourd_pest_management_desc: Watch for fruit flies and apply traps if necessary.
task_bitter_gourd_top_dressing_desc: Apply second dose of Nitrogen fertilizer.
task_bitter_gourd_harvesting_starts_desc: Start harvesting fruits at a tender stage, typically every 2-3 days.
task_okra_sowing_seeds_desc: Sow seeds on ridges or raised beds.
task_okra_thinning_desc: Remove weaker seedlings to maintain proper spacing.
task_okra_first_top_dressing_desc: Apply first dose of Nitrogen fertilizer and do earthing up.
task_okra_pest_watch_jassids_desc: Monitor for Jassids and Yellow Vein Mosaic virus.
task_okra_harvesting_starts_desc: Start picking tender fruits every 1-2 days.
task_tomato_transplanting_desc: Transplant seedlings to the main field.
task_tomato_staking_desc: Provide support to plants using stakes to prevent lodging.
task_tomato_first_fertilization_desc: Apply first dose of NPK after transplanting.
task_tomato_disease_watch_bacterial_wilt: Monitor for signs of bacterial wilt, a common issue in Kerala.
task_tomato_harvesting_starts_desc: Begin harvesting when fruits turn from green to reddish.
task_cucumber_trellis_support_desc: Provide a trellis for the vines to climb.
task_cucumber_fertilization_desc: Apply NPK mixture as a basal dose and top dress later.
task_cucumber_irrigation_desc: Ensure regular watering, especially during flowering.
task_cucumber_harvesting_desc: Harvest cucumbers while they are tender.
task_elephant_foot_yam_planting_corms_de: Plant corm pieces in well-manured pits.
task_elephant_foot_yam_mulching_desc: Apply heavy mulch with organic matter to conserve moisture.
task_elephant_foot_yam_fertilization_ear: Apply NPK fertilizers and mound soil around the plant.
task_elephant_foot_yam_harvesting_desc: Harvest when the plant stem withers and dies down.
task_pineapple_planting_suckers_slips_de: Plant suckers or slips in trenches or on raised beds.
task_pineapple_weed_control_desc: Perform regular weeding to keep the plot clean.
task_pineapple_fertilizer_application_de: Apply NPK mixture as a foliar spray or to the soil.
task_pineapple_flower_induction_desc: Apply Ethrel solution to induce uniform flowering.
task_pineapple_harvesting_desc: Harvest fruits when the base turns golden yellow.
task_jackfruit_basin_preparation_desc: Clean the basin around the tree base before monsoon.
task_jackfruit_fertilization_desc: Apply organic manure and NPK fertilizers in the basin.
task_jackfruit_pruning_desc: Prune dead or diseased branches after the main harvest.
task_mango_fertilizer_application_desc: Apply manures and fertilizers in September-October.
task_mango_pest_management_hopper_desc: Spray insecticide to control mango hoppers during flowering.
task_mango_irrigation_desc: Provide irrigation during fruit development period.
task_coffee_pruning_handling_desc: Perform pruning and shade regulation after harvest.
task_coffee_pre_monsoon_fertilization_de: Apply first dose of NPK after blossom showers.
task_coffee_post_monsoon_fertilization_d: Apply second dose of fertilizers in Sept-Oct.
task_coffee_harvesting_desc: Picking of ripe berries starts from November.
task_arecanut_disease_control_mahali_des: Spray Bordeaux mixture before monsoon as a preventive measure.
task_arecanut_harvesting_season_desc: Harvesting is usually done from December to March.
task_nutmeg_fertilizer_application_desc: Apply organic manure and NPK in May-June.
task_nutmeg_pruning_desc: Remove water shoots and criss-cross branches.
task_nutmeg_harvesting_desc: Harvest when fruits split open, usually year-round with a peak in June-August.
